about: Music beds Inso has ruled on. A film's bed passes G11 music-approved-by-inso only when its file's sha256 is in `approved`: either after Inso's own yes for that track (`inso`, his words), or a bed the Filmmaker made for one film under his standing ruling of 2026-11-07 (`approved_by: "standing ruling 2026-11-07"` with `film`: the production id it counts for, and for no other film; never a quoted yes he did not give), which he judges by ear in the render. Every entry names its licence; an `elevenlabs-unreviewed` licence is reported in the film's delivery note. `references` are beds he praised inside a film, kept as listening references; they are not approvals. `rejected` beds fail with his words, even when they are also in `approved`.
